stem.en: ABC Bakery sells 40 mini cake jars a day at ₹50 each. Each jar costs ₹25 to make. For a festival week it offers the jars at ₹40, and 70 people buy one each day. What is the profit from the jars on one day of the offer, in rupees? (These are made-up numbers.)

explanation.en: With the offer, each jar leaves ₹40 - ₹25 = ₹15, and 70 × ₹15 = ₹1,050. Before the offer it was 40 × ₹25 = ₹1,000. The offer brought 30 more buyers but only ₹50 more profit, so marketing and finance have to plan an offer together.

hints.en: First find what one jar leaves at the offer price: ₹40 minus ₹25.
Then multiply by the 70 jars sold.
